outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map and western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar charts show % HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance per antibody as single bars without any overlaid individual data points or replicate values.
Panel C is a heatmap; individual data points are not applicable to heatmaps.
Panel D is a violin plot, which already displays the underlying data distribution.
Bar charts (mean ± SD, n=4) have individual data points overlaid as circles for each replicate.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a data plot.
Panel G is a scatterplot; the individual points are themselves the data.
Panel H is a scatterplot; the individual points are themselves the data.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot; the individual points are themselves the data.
Panel J shows PCA scatterplots; the individual points are themselves the data.
